blocks.orig: Relax and enjoy the romance of Stone Town from your ‘own’ private traditional but luxurious dhow. Take in the sites of the beautiful old town, local culture, and life at sea. Indulge in succulent seafood freshly grilled on board and sail on to a beautiful sunset. This two-hour sunset dinner cruise is for groups of a maximum of 8 people. It departs from Stone Town at 5 pm and returns at 7 pm.
blocks.html: Lean back on your ‘own’ private dhow, a traditional boat with a luxurious touch, and soak up the romantic atmosphere of Stone Town. Enjoy views of the lovely old town, the local culture and everyday life at sea. On board, tuck into juicy seafood straight off the grill while you sail into a gorgeous sunset. The cruise lasts two hours and is limited to groups of no more than 8 people; it sets sail from Stone Town at 5 pm and is back at 7 pm.
